kebab_example: aliyun chatbot associate --instance-id chatbot-cn-eEf --utterance '干货' --api-version 2017-10-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Associate

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the chatbot
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to specify this parameter when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response. For subsequent conversation turns of the same visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The number of recommended questions. Valid values: 1 to 10. This parameter takes effect only when recommendations are returned. The number of returned recommendations does not exceed the value of RecommendNum
parameters.help_zh: 推荐问题数量，1-10，当出推荐的时候才生效，返回不大于RecommendN
parameters.name: recommend_num

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

Title.description_en: The title of the associated question

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the response message in this conversation turn
